X1_A_StrapSplit.b: Warm blush-cream (#F4E6E1) background. Top 28%: headline in huge heavy near-black sans, two centred lines: "STRAPS SLIPPING?" / "GLUE THEM IN PLACE." Middle 50%: two equal square photo panels side by side with a thin gap. Left panel: close crop of an Indian woman's shoulder in a satin noodle-strap top with the strap slipped down off the shoulder, no face. Right panel: the same shoulder with the strap sitting neatly in place. Between the panels a small arrow. Bottom 14%: a rounded pink (#E9A2B2) pill with near-black text "Savvy Body Glue sticks clothes to skin." At the far right of the middle row nothing else. One small upright Savvy tube in the bottom-left corner. That is ALL the text.

X2_P_WhatIs.b: Warm off-white (#F6EDE9) background, strict clean grid. Top 30%: headline in huge heavy near-black sans, three centred lines: "WHAT IS BODY GLUE?" / "IT STICKS YOUR CLOTHES" / "TO YOUR SKIN." Middle: three equal rounded panels in a row, each a simple flat illustration: panel 1 a hand drawing a thin line along the inside edge of a blouse neckline, panel 2 a small clock, panel 3 a hand pressing the neckline against the skin. Under the panels three short labels in order: "1 Thin line" / "2 Wait 30 sec" / "3 Press". Bottom: one upright Savvy tube and small text "Savvy Body Glue". Accent colour #E9A2B2 only on the panel outlines. That is ALL the text.

X3_F_Neckline.b: Left 55%: a real Indian woman about 28 at a wedding reception, in a saree blouse, glancing down with a mildly annoyed look while one hand holds her neckline in place, warm blurred fairy lights behind, modest framing from the waist up. Right 45% on a clean warm blush-cream (#F4E6E1) panel: headline in huge heavy near-black sans, three stacked lines: "NECKLINE" / "WON'T STAY?" / "USE BODY GLUE." Below, small near-black text: "It sticks clothes to your skin." At the bottom of the panel one upright Savvy tube, large and legible. That is ALL the text.

X4_A_Macro.b: Close-up editorial photograph in soft window light: the edge of a mustard cotton kurti neckline pressed flat against an Indian woman's collarbone skin, a thin clear line of glue visible along the inside edge where fabric meets skin, fabric lying neatly. No face. A Savvy tube rests in the bottom-right corner, sharp and legible. Headline at the top in large heavy near-black sans, two lines: "GLUE THAT STICKS" / "CLOTHES TO SKIN." Small near-black text beneath: "Savvy Body Glue. Up to 8 hours." That is ALL the text.

X5_N_Notes.b: A flat note page filling the whole canvas, cream paper colour (#F4E6E1) with faint horizontal lines, plain default sans-serif typography, no app chrome. Large bold black title: "What is body glue?" Then regular-weight lines, one under the other: "A skin-safe glue that sticks your clothes to your skin." / "Necklines. Straps. Drapes." / "Thin line. Wait 30 seconds. Press." Below the text a small rounded-corner photo inserted into the note showing one upright Savvy tube on a plain white shelf. That is ALL the text.

X6_U_Sign.b: A flat piece of brown cardboard leaning on a wall, photographed with harsh phone flash, slightly crooked. Big messy black marker handwriting: "GLUE FOR YOUR CLOTHES." in two lines, and smaller below: "Sticks necklines and straps to your skin. No pins." One Savvy tube stands upright in front at the bottom right, sharp and legible. No other writing, no doodles.

X7_P_NoPins.b: Solid soft pink (#E9A2B2) background. Top 28%: headline in huge heavy near-black rounded sans, two centred lines: "NO PINS. NO TAPE." / "JUST GLUE." Middle: three equal items in a row with generous space: a silver safety pin with a red cross over it, a strip of clear tape with a red cross over it, and one upright Savvy tube with a green tick. Bottom: a rounded cream (#F4E6E1) pill with near-black text "Body glue sticks clothes to skin." That is ALL the text.
